description: This file contains language-specific localization data for the CKEditor plugin 'a11yhelp', specifically for English ('en'). It defines UI text, instructions, legends, and key references used in accessibility help dialogs within the editor.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: A method called on CKEDITOR.plugins object to set language data for a specific plugin ('a11yhelp') in a specified language ('en').
